name: Companion Figurine (Item Mastery, Mythic)
body:
Your bonded figurine takes life permanently.

Prerequisite(s): Companion Figurine, 7th level character.

Benefit(s): Your figurine is permanently transformed into a companion creature, except if it’s killed it still reverts into its statue form and can be summoned again after one week.

Only a figurine portraying a creature suited to be a normal familiar or animal companion can be permanently brought to life using this feat. Your companion figurine doesn’t gain or retain any special abilities that are not granted by the nonmythic version of the Companion Figurine feat.
